notablePrerequisites: You control at least X Goblins.
easyPrerequisites: Krenko, Mob Boss does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least X 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing two Goblin tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}, untapping Krenko.
Repeat.
